provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.limitations: No tests have been run. Behaviour matches the archived solver, including its quirks, as far as the orientation analysis goes. Exotic edge cases (all-empty lines, extents truncated beyond the segment length) mirror the original only approximately. The solver would fail on inputs without marker cells, which the generator never produces. Fixture-specific behaviour (for example, whether the archived heuristic reproduces every train pair) is inherited from the archived solver. I have not independently confirmed it, and I did not detect any contradiction in the fixtures.
